subject: Thank you for your donation of £$amount
body:
Dear $full_name,

Thank you so much for your generous donation to the university. Your support makes a real difference to our students and community.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
DONATION RECEIPT
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Donor:           $donor_name
Amount:          £$amount
Date:            $donation_date
Fund / Campaign: $campaign
Payment Method:  $payment_method

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Please keep this email as confirmation of your gift. If any of the details above are incorrect, contact the Alumni Relations team and we will be glad to help.

With heartfelt thanks,
The Alumni Relations Team
